|notes=The Players Committee's own card gallery showed this full card on 19 November 2007.<ref name="pc-gallery-uhoh-20071119" /> Its wording matches none of the slip sheets: unlike the [[Uh-oh! (V) (Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire) (Remastered 2006)|Remaster slip of 4 December 2006]] it has no “During your deploy phase” limit, and the ▼ sentence comes last. The same image file is in the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17. The capture proves the wording existed by that day; no source dates it earlier or places it before or after the 2006 slip. {{Mystery|question=When did the Players Committee first publish this wording, and was it ever the official text|section=Errata dated only by "by"|type=card}}
